title: Codex Themes for Codex Desktop | Codex Skin
excerpt: Browse Codex themes and skins for the Codex desktop app. Install, apply, and switch themes on macOS or Windows—and restore the official look offline.
content_html:
Codex themes for the desktop app

Codex themes for
Codex Desktop.

Browse curated Codex themes and skins, then give your Codex workspace a new look on macOS or Windows with the free Codex Skin Plugin.

Free themes available · macOS + Windows

Swipe to browse themes

Personalize your Codex workspace

More than a color theme for Codex.

Codex Skin turns Codex desktop themes into a clear, reversible workflow: discover a look, apply it through the Plugin, switch when you want, and restore the official appearance whenever you need.

01

Browse Codex themes in one gallery.

Compare curated themes, open a dedicated detail view, and see whether each option is Free or Pro.

02

Apply themes from inside Codex.

Copy the stable six-digit theme ID, then continue in Codex through the free Plugin.

03

Switch or restore with confidence.

Themes are data-only, compatibility is checked before a new apply, and offline Restore remains available.

Plugin workflow image 1 of 3

Codex Skin Plugin

Install and apply a Codex theme in three steps.

Use the free, open-source Codex Skin Plugin to bring a theme from this gallery into your Codex workspace. Install the Plugin, copy a six-digit theme ID, then authorize the device and apply.

codex plugin marketplace add yuanjohn01-byte/codex-skin-plugin --ref main codex plugin add codex-skin@codex-skin codex plugin list --json

See how the Plugin works GitHub

1

Install the Codex Skin Plugin

Use the verified Marketplace commands in Codex.

2

Choose a Codex theme

Copy its stable six-digit public theme ID.

3

Apply or switch the theme

Authorize the device when asked, then return to the same Codex task.

Safe Codex customization

Change your Codex theme without losing the way back.

Safe to restore

Return to the official interface without login, access, network, or Plugin cache.

macOS + Windows

One product path with platform-specific verification.

Data-only themes

Signed structured data and images—no arbitrary theme code.

Failures roll back

A failed apply keeps the previous theme or restores the official interface.

Offline Codex theme restore

Restore the official Codex theme—even offline.

Remove the current Codex Skin theme and return your Codex workspace to its official appearance without website login, active Pro access, the Plugin cache, or a network connection.

Read Restore guide

Codex theme FAQ

Codex theme questions, answered.

Yes. Browse themes on the Codex Skin website, then apply one from inside Codex through the free Plugin. The Plugin verifies the app and device before applying.

No. It does not replace the official application package or modify signed system files.

New Pro downloads, updates, switching, and reapplication stop. The appearance currently active on your computer is not remotely removed, and Restore remains available.

Use the offline Restore path to return to the official Codex appearance. It remains available outside the Plugin cache.

Your account returns to Free. New Pro downloads, updates, switching, and reapplication stop. The current appearance is not remotely removed; if you Restore, applying a Pro theme again requires active Pro access.

Codex Skin supports Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows, with platform-specific checks before a theme is applied.
